en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

ar: وَهَبْ لِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ دَيْن تُخْلِقُ بِهِ وَجْهِي،
en: and release me from a debt which makes me lose face,

ar: وَيَحَارُ فِيهِ ذِهْنِي، وَيَتَشَعَّبُ لَهُ فِكْرِي،
en: confuses my mind, disrupts my thinking,
and prolongs my occupation with attending to it!

ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمِّ الدَّيْنِ وَفِكْرِهِ،
en: I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, from worry and thought about debt,
from the distraction and sleeplessness of debt;

ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْهُ.
en: so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge from it!

ar: وَأَسْتَجيرُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ ذِلَّتِهِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ
en: I seek sanctuary in Thee, my Lord, from debt's abasement in life
and its ill effects after death,

ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ
en: so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me sanctuary from it
through a bountiful plenty or a continually arriving sufficiency!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
prevent me from extravagance and excess,
put me on the course of generous spending and moderation,
teach me excellent distribution,
hold me back through Thy gentleness from squandering,
allow me to attain my provisions through lawful means,
direct my spending toward the gateways of devotion,

ar: وَازْوِ عَنِّي مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُحْدِثُ لِي مَخِيلََةً
en: and take away from me any possession which will bring forth pride in me,

ar: أَوْ تَأَدِّياً إلَى بَغْي، أَوْ مَا أَتَعَقَّبُ مِنْهُ طُغْيَـاناً.
en: lead to insolence, or drag me in its heels to rebellion!
O God, make me love the companionship of the poor
and help me be their companion with excellent patience!

ar: وَمَـا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِنْ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَاالفَانِيَةِ
en: Whenever Thou takest away from me the goods of this perishing world,
store them for me in Thy abiding treasuries!
Make this world's broken pieces which Thou hast conferred upon me

ar: وَعَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ مَتَاعِهَا بُلْغَةً إلَى جِوَارِكَ،
en: and its goods which Thou hast quickly granted to me a way to reach Thy neighbourhood,

ar: وَوُصْلَةً إلَى قُرْبِكَ، وَذَرِيعَةً إلَى جَنَّتِكَ
en: a link to Thy nearness, and a means to Thy Garden!
Verily Thou art Possessor of bounty abounding,
and Thou art the Munificent, the Generous.
